open_points.subject: delivery evaluation of A1 orders 1–6
open_points.text: `capability:source_folder.read_named_source` applies condition 1 of A3 rule 5 and reads the file once.
open_points.question: Which named capability evaluates A1 orders 1–6 during delivery, including the pre-open size checks, opened-object checks, read failures, growth past the limit and signature check?
options: `source_folder.read_named_source` evaluates all of A3 rule 5 condition 2 and returns its specific failure
`photo_delivery.deliver_project_photo` evaluates condition 2 from facts returned by `read_named_source`
open_points.default_guess: Make `source_folder.read_named_source` evaluate A1 orders 1–6 and return the corresponding condition-2 failure.

open_points.subject: source hash comparison
open_points.text: `module:photo_delivery` compares the hash of those bytes with the requested source id.
open_points.question: Which capability of `module:photo_delivery` performs this comparison and produces `SOURCE_CHANGED` when it differs?
options: A separate photo-delivery hashing or comparison capability performs it
open_points.default_guess: Assign the comparison and `SOURCE_CHANGED` result to `capability:photo_delivery.deliver_project_photo`.

open_points.subject: opened-file modification time passed to photo preparation
open_points.text: `module:source_folder` hands over one `SourceRead`, a `SourceFile` with the bytes it judged
open_points.question: Which step captures, converts and carries the single metadata reading of the opened file's modification time to `photo_preparation.prepare_photo`, so a no-camera-date publication uses that time rather than the earlier path-listing time?
options: `source_folder.read_named_source` captures and converts the opened-file time and includes it in `SourceRead`
`source_folder.read_named_source` includes the raw opened-file time and `photo_delivery.deliver_project_photo` converts and passes it
Another named operation carries the opened-file time to `photo_preparation.prepare_photo`
open_points.default_guess: Have `source_folder.read_named_source` capture and convert the opened-file modification time and return it in `SourceRead`.
